package.name: delphi_esr_driver
package.description:
INTERFACES ONLY. A message-definition-only mirror of the Delphi ESR 2.5 driver package that lives at https://github.com/JonasLos/delphi_esr_driver, so the perception containers can deserialize /delphi_esr_interface/radar/tracks without pulling in the driver's CAN stack.
This package deliberately shares the NAME of the real driver package: a ROS 2 message's DDS type name is "<package>/msg/<Message>", so a copy under any other name would not match the publisher. The three .msg files are byte-identical copies of upstream and must stay that way -- test_delphi_msgs_vendored.py enforces it.
Do NOT install this on the vehicle host or add it to install_host_custom_msgs.sh. The host has the real delphi_esr_driver, which also contains the driver node; shadowing it with this stub would remove the node from that overlay.
